messages:
sam: Trying to get the TS SDK working in an Expo managed app (Hermes). Crashed immediately: `TypeError: crypto.getRandomValues is not a function`. Minimal repro attached.
maria: Hermes has no WebCrypto. For RN we add `react-native-get-random-values` + Buffer shim. Are you prepending the shim before imports?
sam: I put `import 'react-native-get-random-values'` at top of App.tsx but the crash happens inside node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.mjs during module evaluation. Looks like metro picks the .mjs module and it runs before our app code executes.
lee: Metro's resolver can prefer .mjs/module fields; also Expo's entrypoint ordering matters. Two workarounds: 1) use an explicit `shim.js` as the entrypoint so it runs before the bundle; 2) force the SDK to publish a cjs entrypoint and update package.json exports so RN picks cjs.
sam: Repro steps that fail for me: Expo managed -> Hermes -> npm install @redwood/sdk -> import {createClient} from '@redwood/sdk' -> crash.
maria: Quick shim to try: 
```
// shim.js
import 'react-native-get-random-values';
import { Buffer } from 'buffer';
global.Buffer = Buffer;
if (!global.crypto) {
  global.crypto = { getRandomValues: require('react-native-get-random-values').getRandomValues };
}
```
and set app.json: `{ "expo": { "entryPoint": "./shim.js" } }`
lee: Also note streaming: RN fetch in Expo does NOT expose ReadableStream. If SDK assumes `response.body` is a ReadableStream and calls `pipeTo`/`getReader()`, it will break. SDK should detect environment and fall back to reading `arrayBuffer()` or `text()` on RN.
sam: Yep stack shows SDK hitting streaming chat path which expects incremental tokens. On Expo I only get whole responses. That suggests we need a runtime switch to fallback to non-streaming mode.
maria: On auth: saw another issue where token refresh + retry logic causes duplicate POSTs on RN. Because fetch can't be aborted and our retry wrapper simply replays the request, flaky mobile networks generate double requests with side-effects. Repro: token expires -> first request 401 -> refresh triggered -> concurrent requests also trigger refresh and replay -> server sees duplicates.
lee: Solution: implement a singleflight refresh lock so only one refresh runs and others await it. Also add an idempotency/dedupe window for retrying POSTs in the SDK or make autoretry opt-in for mobile via env var.
maria: I'll propose `REDWOOD_SDK_AUTORETRY=1/0` and a `dedupeWindowMs` option. Also add tests simulating RN fetch behavior (no streams, no abort).
sam: Types: SDK types currently declare `ReadableStream` for streaming responses. We should widen to `ReadableStream | ArrayBuffer | string` so RN typings pass. Also export a `isReactNative` helper or auto-detect to pick runtime paths.
lee: For packaging: we'll add a `react-native` entry in package.json that points to a cjs build and include an `expo` sample in `examples/` that uses the shim. Also adjust exports map to include `./dist/cjs/index.js` for node/react-native.
dev-rel-bot: Created issue #1302: expo-hermes-rn: shim + cjs entry + streaming fallback + auth singleflight. Assignee: lee.
maria: I'll own auth singleflight + tests. Will add a small mutex around token refresh and a concurrent queue. Also ensure refresh failures bubble so callers can surface errors rather than silently retrying.
sam: Thanks. I'll try the shim + entryPoint approach and report. If that works I'll share the minimal repro for the examples dir.
maria: One more note: Metro `mainFields` ordering helps. Example metro.config snippet: 
```
module.exports = {
  resolver: {
    sourceExts: ['js','json','ts','tsx','cjs'],
    mainFields: ['react-native','main','module']
  }
}
```
lee: Great. We'll aim to land a tiny expo template + README with steps to run on Expo Go and on dev client with Hermes. PRs welcome.
dev-rel-bot: Added label: devex/mobile, priority: P2.
